nodes.label: Tabs activation default flips to manual
nodes.norm_label: tabs activation default flips to manual
nodes.rationale: Radix defaults to automatic activation and Base UI 1.6.0 defaults to manual (List.activateOnFocus false); activationMode="manual" becomes an omission, and preserving Radix default means explicitly setting activateOnFocus, which the skill says to flag rather than auto-add.

nodes.label: closeOnClick defaults false on menu check/radio items
nodes.norm_label: closeonclick defaults false on menu check/radio items
nodes.rationale: Radix closed menus on select by default while Base UI defaults closeOnClick to false on CheckboxItem/RadioItem, so parity requires an explicit closeOnClick; the skill flags this rather than auto-adding it.

nodes.label: Flag behavior deltas, never silently patch
nodes.norm_label: flag behavior deltas, never silently patch
nodes.rationale: The target is idiomatic Base UI matching the shadcn base registry; deltas that compile fine but act differently (tabs activation, menu close-on-click, hover delays) are reported honestly instead of being papered over.

nodes.label: Legacy styles: classify only, no golden replay
nodes.norm_label: legacy styles: classify only, no golden replay
nodes.rationale: Legacy styles (new-york, new-york-v4, default) have no base counterpart; retargeting onto a base-<style> variant would restyle the user's app, so the radix golden is used only to detect customizations and the engine transforms the user's own file.

nodes.label: Positioner Pick-means-forward rule
nodes.rationale: If a wrapper Pick<>s Positioner props but does not destructure and forward them, they fall through ...props onto the Popup (wrong DOM node) and positioning silently breaks; no type error catches it, so the checklist is declare -> destructure -> forward, every time.

nodes.norm_label: solution b alt: external usb wifi antenna
nodes.rationale: Cheaper and quicker than cabling the factory, keeps the DCC mobile and positions the antenna outside the metal cabinet, but it is a signal fix rather than a link fix since WiFi and AP coverage remain.

nodes.label: Solution C: live kiosk software update
nodes.norm_label: solution c: live kiosk software update
nodes.rationale: Hardware changes alone will not help if the live kiosk software still assumes the old WiFi path - endpoint/address config, reader-to-Pi communication, reconnection and fallback must move together with the wiring.

nodes.label: Solution B: direct Ethernet for Raspberry Pi
nodes.norm_label: solution b: direct ethernet for raspberry pi
nodes.rationale: Evidence: DCC/Pi reachable in only 32.9% of checks and 14 DCCs never answered from the Pi side; direct Ethernet removes shared radio conditions but requires cabling all 32 locations and limits moving the DCC.

nodes.label: Next.js request.url is internal behind a proxy
nodes.norm_label: next.js request.url is internal behind a proxy
nodes.rationale: Next.js Route Handlers build request.url from the internal proxy URL and do not reliably honour forwarded Host/X-Forwarded headers, so request.url must be treated as internal-only when self-hosting behind a reverse proxy.

nodes.label: Build absolute redirects from env.APP_URL
nodes.rationale: env.APP_URL is explicit, validated, and already required for the Azure redirect_uri to work, so using it for every redirect is deterministic and proxy-independent, whereas request.url depends on how the reverse proxy preserves hosts.
